description:
This process begins with monitoring inventory levels in a warehouse or store.
When stock reaches a predefined threshold, an automated alert or manual check signals the need to reorder.
The procurement team then places an order with suppliers, considering factors like cost, delivery time, and supplier reliability.
Once the order is placed, the inventory system updates with expected delivery dates.
Upon receiving the stock, it is inspected for quality, recorded in the system, and placed on shelves or in storage.
The process ends when the inventory levels are updated after the restock is complete.

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Inventory_Restock" name="Inventory Restock Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Inventory_Restock">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Inventory_System" name="Inventory System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Monitoring</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MonitorStock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ThresholdReached</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SignalReorder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_InventoryUpdated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Procurement_Team" name="Procurement Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateSuppliers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehouse_Staff" name="Warehouse Staff">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveStock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InspectQuality</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordStock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StoreStock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Monitoring" name="Inventory monitoring begins"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorStock" name="Monitor inventory levels in warehouse or store"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ThresholdReached" name="Reorder threshold reached?" default="Flow_Threshold_Not_Reached"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SignalReorder" name="Signal reorder need (automated alert or manual check)"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateSuppliers" name="Evaluate suppliers by cost, delivery time and reliability"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order with supplier"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" name="Update inventory system with expected delivery dates"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveStock" name="Receive stock"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_InspectQuality" name="Inspect stock quality"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordStock" name="Record stock in system"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_StoreStock" name="Place stock on shelves or in storage"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_InventoryUpdated" name="Inventory levels updated after restock"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Monitor" sourceRef="StartEvent_Monitoring" targetRef="Task_MonitorStock"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Monitor_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_MonitorStock" targetRef="Gateway_ThresholdReached"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Threshold_Reached" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ThresholdReached" targetRef="Task_SignalReorder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${reorderThresholdReached}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Threshold_Not_Reached" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ThresholdReached" targetRef="Task_MonitorStock"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Signal_Evaluate" sourceRef="Task_SignalReorder" targetRef="Task_EvaluateSuppliers"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Evaluate_Order" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateSuppliers" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_UpdateDelivery" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateDelivery_Receive" sourceRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStock"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Inspect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStock" targetRef="Task_InspectQuality"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_Record" sourceRef="Task_InspectQuality" targetRef="Task_RecordStock"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_Store" sourceRef="Task_RecordStock" targetRef="Task_StoreStock"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Store_End" sourceRef="Task_StoreStock" targetRef="EndEvent_InventoryUpdated"/>
  </bpmn:process>
